personality_one_liner: A deeply tonal, adaptive, and premium productivity hub where rich mossy surfaces and expressive typography create a calming, focused environment.

spacing.rule: Use adaptive tonal layering instead of hard shadows. Margins should be generous (lg/xl) to let content breathe. Elements within cards use md spacing.

do's: Apply to bottom tab bar and sticky headers.
Use over the hero abstract background image.
Pair with a ≥75% opacity tinted base under the blur for readability.
dont's: Do not apply to body text cards or dense list items.
Do not use transparent glass over high-contrast raw photos without a scrim.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: A personalized hub offering an immediate glance at daily insights, quick tools, and AI suggestions.

states.error: Card displaying 'Unable to load insights' with a retry button in brandSecondary.

screens.layout: Compact top app bar with greeting and avatar. Below, a large Hero Card featuring the moss gradient background with a 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface). Inside the hero card: Daily insight text and a primary 'Start Focus' action. Below hero: A bento grid (flexWrap: 'wrap', gap: md) for 'Quick Actions' (Notes, AI Chat, etc.), each in a surfaceSecondary card with a brandTertiary tinted icon container. Followed by a horizontal scrolling list for 'Favorite Tools'.

screens.name: All Tools
screens.purpose: A categorized directory of all productivity, AI, and utility tools.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty desk with 'No tools found in this category' text.
states.error: Text stating 'Error loading tools' + Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Sticky header with a large Search bar (surfaceTertiary background, pill shape). Below search, a horizontal scrollable row of filter chips (Productivity, AI, Health). The main content is a 2-column grid of tool cards. Each card uses surfaceSecondary, lg radius, with the tool icon wrapped in a brandTertiary rounded square.

screens.name: Habit Tracker
screens.purpose: Visualizes streaks and daily completions to build momentum.

states.empty: Illustration of a seed/sprout with 'Start a new habit today' and a primary FAB.

screens.layout: Top section features a 'Today' dashboard showing a giant streak number (DisplayFontFamily, 3xl+) and a 'Keep the momentum going' subtitle. Below, a calendar/heatmap grid showing weekly completion (colored dots/tiles using brandPrimary for completed). A prominent primary FAB pinned to the bottom right for logging a new habit.

screens.name: Pomodoro Focus Timer
screens.purpose: A distraction-free, visually calming circular timer for focused work sessions.
screens.layout: Minimalist layout. A large circular timer ring in the center of the screen, with the remaining time in bold display typography inside. Above the timer: subtle pill-shaped mode controls (Pomodoro, Short Break, Long Break). Below the timer: A large, pill-shaped Play/Pause primary button. Background is solid surface to reduce distractions.

dashboard_hero_bg.alt: Abstract dark moss green gradient background

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a deep, tonal Material You (Dark-first) theme using the Moss/Emerald color tokens provided. Avoid harsh shadows; rely on surface color layering for elevation.
For the Dashboard Hero card, use the provided abstract moss background with a strict 3-stop vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surface) to ensure text readability.
Ensure the Pomodoro Timer uses a large, clean SVG-based circular progress ring, keeping the screen minimal and distraction-free as per research.
Habit Tracker must focus on the 'Streak' visualization prominently (giant numbers, calendar heatmap).
Use 'Outfit' for expressive, rounded display headings and 'Geist' for clean, readable body/UI text.
Keep standard padding large (16-24pt) to make the app feel premium and uncluttered, similar to top-tier productivity apps.
Ensure all primary actions (like 'Log Habit' or 'Start Focus') are easily accessible in the thumb zone (bottom 1/3 of the screen).
